description: The transcripts of MAGICDATA Mandarin Chinese Read Speech Corpus. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are MAGICDATA's `TRANS.txt` files, inside archives that total about 55 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
